what: The line pattern behind the section (if left empty, it draws vertical lines and a 27° diagonal bundle in the accent color) shows only inside a soft ellipse (screen width × .5, height × 666/719) that trails the cursor with .8s power2.out, while a 60-cell stripe mask flickers inside it at 30 cells per second. On touch devices an ellipse of screen width × 1.2 sits at the screen center

options.size: Ellipse width = Screen width × size, default .5
options.touch: Oval width share on touch devices, default 1.2
options.follow: Cursor follow duration (seconds), default .8 — one value used across the whole page
options.flicker: When off, only a blurred ellipse with no stripe flicker
options.--fx-line: CSS variable — default pattern line color, default accent color

from.where: shared.js TB.grid (yellow line pattern .tb-grid in each section) — original cursorMask (mask-circle-blur 1438×1332 + 5000×83 stripes 60 cells 30fps, mask-composite intersect)

note: Instead of the original mask images (blurred circles, striped band), it uses CSS radial gradients and SVG stripes of the same size and cell count. The plate itself has no pointer-events
